widget.name: Trimm MultiDatepicker
widget.description: Multi-date picker for selecting multiple dates, CSV storage, Mendix 11 compatible.

property.caption: Selected Dates (CSV)
property.description: Comma-separated string of selected dates (yyyy-MM-dd), e.g. 2025-06-04,2025-06-07.

property.caption: Date To Toggle
property.description: Helper: last date clicked, used for toggling. String (yyyy-MM-dd).

property.caption: On Date Toggle
property.description: Action to run when user toggles a date. Must read `selectedDateToToggle` from entity.

property.caption: Show calendar icon
property.description: Show calendar icon in input field.

property.caption: Locale
property.description: Locale code for date formatting and day/month names (e.g. en-US, nl-NL).
